verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents workflows that can be created, updated, run, and deleted through the SDK or REST API, and jobs that can be monitored. Nothing in the evidence shows workflow version history, change review, or rollback to a prior version. Updating a workflow in place is an adjacent capability, not versioning or rollback, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
